name: Morel
identity: older grassland alchemist; one blue flask in the RIGHT hand, a closed reagent case on the RIGHT hip, the catalyst apparatus at the LEFT hip, one mask on the chest (on the face in the special)
home_region_note: Claude K's proposal on #149 (25 Oct), not yet decided by Matt; it only sets the tier material

abilities.kit: game/data/abilities/morel.json (Codex, #261); base and powered form unchanged

techniques.name: Tacky Reagent
techniques.effect: Foes standing in a patch move slower.

upgrade.name: Tacky Reagent II
upgrade.effect: Slowed foes take more from a Catalyst spark.

techniques.name: Mineral Skin
techniques.binding: throw a flask at your own feet (aim within 1.5 tiles)
techniques.effect: Instead of a patch, a mineral skin softens the next hit you take.

fx: mineral sheen on the body (finite, 3 drawings)

upgrade.name: Mineral Skin II
upgrade.effect: The skin also clears burn, chill and shock.

techniques.name: Drowsy Fume
techniques.binding: Catalyst through three or more patches at once
techniques.effect: A fume rises from the chain and makes foes in it attack half as often for a short time.

upgrade.name: Drowsy Fume II
upgrade.effect: The fume spreads to patches next to it.
